name: charts-echarts
description: Teaches the assistant to draw bar, stacked bar, line, area, pie, donut and scatter charts in chat with the Apache ECharts chart provider: finding the chart components with search_components, the data shape each one takes, several series in one chart through the generic chart.spec entry, axis names and number formats, and what falls back to a table. Know-how only: no code, no MCP server; the ECharts provider plugin (charts-echarts) draws the charts and switches this plugin on and off.

tovu.summary: Lets the assistant draw bar, stacked bar, line, area, pie, donut and scatter charts in chat, with several series. Ask for a chart of your data.
